## Evidence

- [ ] Scope and relevant decisions are linked.
- [ ] Windows build, tests and privacy checks passed.
- [ ] Migration impact, failure handling and existing data compatibility are recorded.
- [ ] Normal, boundary and conflict cases are covered where applicable.
- [ ] Windows GUI and offline checks report what was actually tested.
- [ ] Demo walkthrough, screenshots or known limitations are recorded as applicable.
- [ ] Changes and evidence use synthetic data. No source customer material is included.
